fullContentHtml:
RRB NTPC 10+2 UG CBT-I Result / Score Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the result for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level Post on the official website of RRB after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 3058 posts. Applications for the RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 28 October 2025, to 04 December 2025. The examination was held from 7, 8, 9 May & 13, 14, 15, 16, 20 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RRB NTPC 10+2 UG CBT-I Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 October 2025
  • Last Date : 04 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 December 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 07 December 2025 to 16 December 2025
  • Application Status : 06 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 7, 8, 9 May & 13, 14, 15, 16, 20 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 27 June 2026
  • Result : 24 August 2026
  • Score Card : 26 August 2026
  • CBT II Exam Date : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
